title: PulseSteal
description: A fully configurable LifeSteal plugin.... With revival system and much more....
body:
❤️ PulseSteal – The Ultimate LifeSteal Plugin

Turn your server into an adrenaline-fueled SMP with PulseSteal!
Players gain hearts by killing others and lose them on death, creating a high-stakes PvP environment where every fight matters. Ideal for SMPs, factions, and hardcore survival servers.

✨ Features
⚔️ LifeSteal Core

Heart Stealing – Players gain hearts by killing others.

Customizable Heart Rules – Set minimum and maximum heart limits.

Elimination System – Decide what happens when players hit 0 hearts: ban, spectator mode, respawn with cooldown, or configurable punishment.

Heart Items – Hearts can be crafted, dropped, or traded as special items.

⚙️ Customization

Configurable Heart Gain/Loss – Choose how many hearts are stolen per kill.

Crafting & Shops – Add recipes or allow hearts to be bought with Vault-compatible economy.

Full Message Customization – Edit all messages, colors, and titles in config.

Permission Support – Give VIPs or ranks bonus features (extra hearts, revive commands, etc.).

🎮 Player Experience

Scoreboards & Action Bars – Display current hearts, kills, and stats.

Death Announcements – Broadcast when someone is eliminated.

Leaderboards – Track top players by hearts or kills.

Revival System – Admins or special items can bring back eliminated players.

🛡️ Anti-Abuse & Stability

Alt Detection – Prevent farming hearts from the same player.

Cooldowns – Configure delays on heart stealing to keep fights fair.

Optimized for Performance – Lightweight and lag-free, even on large servers.
